# Fahm

> Fahm (فهم, "understanding") is a mobile app that teaches the meaning of every word Muslims say in salah (the five daily prayers), word by word, in 5 minutes a day over 30 days. English and French. Free to start; Premium by subscription or one-time purchase. Android on Google Play; iPhone coming soon.

Key facts:
- Follows one prayer in order, from the opening takbir to the final salam, then the adhkar after prayer, Witr and Ramadan.
- Each lesson: every word on its own (Arabic, transliteration, meaning, recitation audio for Quran words), then the whole phrase, then a short quiz. Learned words come back for spaced review.
- Also: a daily reminder that teaches one phrase, an After Salah pack, a Ramadan pack, a kids mode, and a home screen widget.
- Prayer phrases reviewed by a qualified teacher. Quran text, word-by-word data and recitations from Quran.com.
- No account and no ads in the app; progress stays on the phone. Optional ad measurement with Meta, only with the user's consent.
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.fahm.fahm
- Contact: medaminealyate@gmail.com

## The words of salah, explained (English)

- [Allahu Akbar](https://fahmsalah.com/salah/allahu-akbar/): Allāhu akbar (اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ) means "Allah is the Greatest." Said to begin the prayer and at every change of position.
  Word by word: اللَّهُ Allāhu = Allah; أَكْبَرُ akbar = is the Greatest.
  Note: Said to begin the prayer and when moving between positions. Everything else is smaller than Allah, so leave the world behind.
- [Subhanaka Allahumma](https://fahmsalah.com/salah/subhanaka-allahumma/): Subḥānaka Allāhumma wa biḥamdika, wa tabāraka-smuka, wa taʿālā jadduka, wa lā ilāha ghayruk (سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ، وَتَعَالَى جَدُّكَ، وَلَا إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ) means "Glory be to You, O Allah, and praise. Blessed is Your name, exalted is Your majesty, and there is no god but You." Said after the opening takbir, before Al-Fatiha.
  Word by word: سُبْحَانَكَ Subḥānaka = Glory be to You; اللَّهُمَّ Allāhumma = O Allah; وَبِحَمْدِكَ wa biḥamdika = and with Your praise; وَتَبَارَكَ wa tabāraka = and blessed is; اسْمُكَ -smuka = Your name; وَتَعَالَى wa taʿālā = and exalted is; جَدُّكَ jadduka = Your majesty; وَلَا إِلَهَ wa lā ilāha = and there is no god; غَيْرُكَ ghayruk = other than You.
  Note: One of several authentic opening supplications. It is recommended, not obligatory.
- [A'udhu billahi minash shaytanir rajim](https://fahmsalah.com/salah/audhu-billahi-minash-shaytanir-rajim/): Aʿūdhu billāhi mina sh-shayṭāni r-rajīm (أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ) means "I seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the rejected." Said before reciting Al-Fatiha.
  Word by word: أَعُوذُ Aʿūdhu = I seek refuge; بِاللَّهِ billāhi = in Allah; مِنَ mina = from; الشَّيْطَانِ sh-shayṭāni = Satan; الرَّجِيمِ r-rajīm = the rejected.
  Note: Said quietly before reciting Al-Fatiha.
- [Subhana Rabbiyal Azim](https://fahmsalah.com/salah/subhana-rabbiyal-azim/): Subḥāna Rabbiya l-ʿAẓīm (سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْعَظِيمِ) means "Glory be to my Lord, the Most Great." Said in ruku', while bowing.
  Word by word: سُبْحَانَ Subḥāna = Glory be to; رَبِّيَ Rabbiya = my Lord; الْعَظِيمِ l-ʿAẓīm = the Most Great.
  Note: Usually said three times. You bow your body and declare His greatness.
- [Sami Allahu liman hamidah](https://fahmsalah.com/salah/sami-allahu-liman-hamidah/): Samiʿa Allāhu liman ḥamidah (سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ) means "Allah hears the one who praises Him." Said while rising from ruku'.
  Word by word: سَمِعَ Samiʿa = hears; اللَّهُ Allāhu = Allah; لِمَنْ liman = the one who; حَمِدَهُ ḥamidah = praises Him.
  Note: Said while rising. Allah is listening, so the answer comes next.
- [Rabbana wa lakal hamd](https://fahmsalah.com/salah/rabbana-wa-lakal-hamd/): Rabbanā wa laka l-ḥamd (رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ) means "Our Lord, and to You belongs all praise." Said standing straight after ruku'.
  Word by word: رَبَّنَا Rabbanā = Our Lord; وَلَكَ wa laka = and to You belongs; الْحَمْدُ l-ḥamd = all praise.
  Note: Your reply to 'Allah hears the one who praises Him'.
- [Subhana Rabbiyal A'la](https://fahmsalah.com/salah/subhana-rabbiyal-ala/): Subḥāna Rabbiya l-Aʿlā (سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْأَعْلَى) means "Glory be to my Lord, the Most High." Said in sujud, while prostrating.
  Word by word: سُبْحَانَ Subḥāna = Glory be to; رَبِّيَ Rabbiya = my Lord; الْأَعْلَى l-Aʿlā = the Most High.
  Note: Usually said three times. At your lowest point, you praise the Most High.
- [Rabbighfir li](https://fahmsalah.com/salah/rabbighfirli/): Rabbi-ghfir lī (رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي) means "My Lord, forgive me." Said sitting between the two prostrations.
  Word by word: رَبِّ Rabbi = My Lord; اغْفِرْ -ghfir = forgive; لِي lī = me.
  Note: Often said twice while sitting between the two prostrations.
- [Attahiyat](https://fahmsalah.com/salah/attahiyat/): At-taḥiyyātu lillāhi waṣ-ṣalawātu waṭ-ṭayyibāt, as-salāmu ʿalayka ayyuha n-nabiyyu wa raḥmatullāhi wa barakātuh, as-salāmu ʿalaynā wa ʿalā ʿibādillāhi ṣ-ṣāliḥīn (التَّحِيَّاتُ لِلَّهِ وَالصَّلَوَاتُ وَالطَّيِّبَاتُ، السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ، السَّلَامُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ) means "All greetings, prayers and good things are for Allah. Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings. Peace be upon us and upon the righteous servants of Allah." Said in the sitting position (tashahhud).
  Word by word: التَّحِيَّاتُ At-taḥiyyātu = All greetings; لِلَّهِ lillāhi = are for Allah; وَالصَّلَوَاتُ waṣ-ṣalawātu = and the prayers; وَالطَّيِّبَاتُ waṭ-ṭayyibāt = and the good things; السَّلَامُ as-salāmu = Peace be; عَلَيْكَ ʿalayka = upon you; أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ ayyuha n-nabiyyu = O Prophet; وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ wa raḥmatullāhi = and the mercy of Allah; وَبَرَكَاتُهُ wa barakātuh = and His blessings; السَّلَامُ عَلَيْنَا as-salāmu ʿalaynā = Peace be upon us; وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ wa ʿalā ʿibādillāhi = and upon the servants of Allah; الصَّالِحِينَ ṣ-ṣāliḥīn = the righteous.
  Note: The wording of Ibn Mas'ud, reported by al-Bukhari and Muslim. Other authentic wordings exist.
- [Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah](https://fahmsalah.com/salah/ashhadu-an-la-ilaha-illallah/): Ash-hadu an lā ilāha illallāh, wa ash-hadu anna Muḥammadan ʿabduhu wa rasūluh (أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ) means "I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and His Messenger." Said in the tashahhud, right after the greetings.
  Word by word: أَشْهَدُ Ash-hadu = I bear witness; أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ an lā ilāha = that there is no god; إِلَّا اللَّهُ illallāh = except Allah; وَأَشْهَدُ wa ash-hadu = and I bear witness; أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا anna Muḥammadan = that Muhammad; عَبْدُهُ ʿabduhu = is His servant; وَرَسُولُهُ wa rasūluh = and His Messenger.
  Note: The testimony of faith, renewed in every prayer.
- [Allahumma salli ala Muhammad](https://fahmsalah.com/salah/allahumma-salli-ala-muhammad/): Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli Muḥammad, kamā ṣallayta ʿalā Ibrāhīma wa ʿalā āli Ibrāhīm, innaka Ḥamīdun Majīd (اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ) means "O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You sent prayers upon Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim. You are Praiseworthy, Glorious." Said in the final sitting, after the tashahhud.
  Word by word: اللَّهُمَّ Allāhumma = O Allah; صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammadin = send prayers upon Muhammad; وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ wa ʿalā āli Muḥammad = and upon the family of Muhammad; كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ kamā ṣallayta = as You sent prayers; عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ ʿalā Ibrāhīma = upon Ibrahim; وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ wa ʿalā āli Ibrāhīm = and upon the family of Ibrahim; إِنَّكَ innaka = indeed You are; حَمِيدٌ Ḥamīdun = Praiseworthy; مَجِيدٌ Majīd = Glorious.
  Note: Said in the final sitting. One of the authentic wordings, reported by al-Bukhari.
- [Allahumma barik ala Muhammad](https://fahmsalah.com/salah/allahumma-barik-ala-muhammad/): Allāhumma bārik ʿalā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli Muḥammad, kamā bārakta ʿalā Ibrāhīma wa ʿalā āli Ibrāhīm, innaka Ḥamīdun Majīd (اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ) means "O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You blessed Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim. You are Praiseworthy, Glorious." Said in the final sitting, right after the salawat.
  Word by word: اللَّهُمَّ Allāhumma = O Allah; بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ bārik ʿalā Muḥammadin = bless Muhammad; وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ wa ʿalā āli Muḥammad = and the family of Muhammad; كَمَا بَارَكْتَ kamā bārakta = as You blessed; عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ ʿalā Ibrāhīma = Ibrahim; وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ wa ʿalā āli Ibrāhīm = and the family of Ibrahim; إِنَّكَ innaka = indeed You are; حَمِيدٌ Ḥamīdun = Praiseworthy; مَجِيدٌ Majīd = Glorious.
  Note: The second half of the prayers on the Prophet ﷺ.
- [Assalamu alaykum wa rahmatullah](https://fahmsalah.com/salah/assalamu-alaykum-wa-rahmatullah/): As-salāmu ʿalaykum wa raḥmatullāh (السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ) means "Peace be upon you and the mercy of Allah." Said to end the prayer, turning to the right, then to the left.
  Word by word: السَّلَامُ As-salāmu = Peace; عَلَيْكُمْ ʿalaykum = be upon you; وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ wa raḥmatullāh = and the mercy of Allah.
  Note: Said turning the head to the right, then to the left.
- [Astaghfirullah](https://fahmsalah.com/salah/astaghfirullah/): Astaghfirullāh (أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ) means "I ask Allah for forgiveness." Said right after the salam of an obligatory prayer.
  Word by word: أَسْتَغْفِرُ Astaghfiru = I ask forgiveness of; اللَّهَ llāh = Allah.
  Note: Said three times right after the salam (Muslim). Even after worship, we ask forgiveness for its shortcomings.
- [Allahumma antas salam](https://fahmsalah.com/salah/allahumma-antas-salam/): Allāhumma anta s-Salām, wa minka s-salām, tabārakta yā Dha l-Jalāli wa l-Ikrām (اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ، وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ) means "O Allah, You are Peace and from You comes peace. Blessed are You, O Possessor of Majesty and Honour." Said right after the prayer, after Astaghfirullah.
  Word by word: اللَّهُمَّ Allāhumma = O Allah; أَنْتَ anta = You are; السَّلَامُ s-Salām = Peace; وَمِنْكَ wa minka = and from You; السَّلَامُ s-salām = (comes) peace; تَبَارَكْتَ tabārakta = Blessed are You; يَا ذَا yā Dha = O Possessor of; الْجَلَالِ l-Jalāli = Majesty; وَالْإِكْرَامِ wa l-Ikrām = and Honour.
  Note: Said once, after the istighfar (Muslim). As-Salām, Peace, is one of the names of Allah.
- [SubhanAllah](https://fahmsalah.com/salah/subhanallah/): Subḥāna llāh (سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ) means "Glory be to Allah." Said after the obligatory prayer, and at any time.
  Word by word: سُبْحَانَ Subḥāna = Glory be to; اللَّهِ llāh = Allah.
  Note: Said 33 times after the obligatory prayer (Muslim). You declare Allah above every imperfection.
- [Alhamdulillah](https://fahmsalah.com/salah/alhamdulillah/): Al-ḥamdu lillāh (الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ) means "All praise is for Allah." Said after the obligatory prayer, and at any time.
  Word by word: الْحَمْدُ Al-ḥamdu = All praise; لِلَّهِ lillāh = is for Allah.
  Note: Said 33 times (Muslim). The same words that open Al-Fatiha.
- [La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah](https://fahmsalah.com/salah/la-ilaha-illallahu-wahdahu-la-sharika-lah/): Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahu l-mulku wa lahu l-ḥamd, wa huwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr (لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ) means "There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is capable of all things." Said after the obligatory prayer, completing the hundred.
  Word by word: لَا إِلَهَ lā ilāha = there is no god; إِلَّا اللَّهُ illallāhu = except Allah; وَحْدَهُ waḥdahu = alone; لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ lā sharīka lah = with no partner; لَهُ الْمُلْكُ lahu l-mulku = His is the dominion; وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ wa lahu l-ḥamd = and His is the praise; وَهُوَ wa huwa = and He is; عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ ʿalā kulli shayʾin = over all things; قَدِيرٌ qadīr = capable.
  Note: Said once to complete the hundred. Whoever says these after every prayer has their sins forgiven, even if they were like the foam of the sea (Muslim).
- [Allahumma la mani'a lima a'tayta](https://fahmsalah.com/salah/allahumma-la-mania-lima-atayta/): Allāhumma lā māniʿa limā aʿṭayt, wa lā muʿṭiya limā manaʿt, wa lā yanfaʿu dha l-jaddi minka l-jadd (اللَّهُمَّ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ) means "O Allah, none can withhold what You give, none can give what You withhold, and no one's fortune can help them against You." Said after the obligatory prayer.
  Word by word: اللَّهُمَّ Allāhumma = O Allah; لَا مَانِعَ lā māniʿa = none can withhold; لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ limā aʿṭayt = what You give; وَلَا مُعْطِيَ wa lā muʿṭiya = and none can give; لِمَا مَنَعْتَ limā manaʿt = what You withhold; وَلَا يَنْفَعُ wa lā yanfaʿu = and does not help; ذَا الْجَدِّ dha l-jaddi = the one with fortune; مِنْكَ minka = against You; الْجَدُّ l-jadd = his fortune.
  Note: The Prophet ﷺ said this after the tahlil at the end of every obligatory prayer (al-Bukhari, Muslim).
- [Allahumma a'inni ala dhikrika](https://fahmsalah.com/salah/allahumma-ainni-ala-dhikrika/): Allāhumma aʿinnī ʿalā dhikrika wa shukrika wa ḥusni ʿibādatik (اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ) means "O Allah, help me to remember You, to thank You, and to worship You well." Said after the prayer.
  Word by word: اللَّهُمَّ Allāhumma = O Allah; أَعِنِّي aʿinnī = help me; عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ ʿalā dhikrika = to remember You; وَشُكْرِكَ wa shukrika = and to thank You; وَحُسْنِ wa ḥusni = and to do well; عِبَادَتِكَ ʿibādatik = Your worship.
  Note: The Prophet ﷺ told Muʿādh never to leave saying this at the end of every prayer (Abu Dawud, al-Nasa'i).
- [Dua Qunut (Witr)](https://fahmsalah.com/salah/dua-qunut-witr/): Allāhumma-hdinī fīman hadayt, wa ʿāfinī fīman ʿāfayt, wa tawallanī fīman tawallayt, wa bārik lī fīmā aʿṭayt, wa qinī sharra mā qaḍayt, fa innaka taqḍī wa lā yuqḍā ʿalayk, wa innahu lā yadhillu man wālayt, tabārakta Rabbanā wa taʿālayt (اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي فِيمَنْ هَدَيْتَ، وَعَافِنِي فِيمَنْ عَافَيْتَ، وَتَوَلَّنِي فِيمَنْ تَوَلَّيْتَ، وَبَارِكْ لِي فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَقِنِي شَرَّ مَا قَضَيْتَ، فَإِنَّكَ تَقْضِي وَلَا يُقْضَى عَلَيْكَ، وَإِنَّهُ لَا يَذِلُّ مَنْ وَالَيْتَ، تَبَارَكْتَ رَبَّنَا وَتَعَالَيْتَ) means "O Allah, guide me among those You have guided, grant me well-being among those You have granted well-being, take me into Your care among those You have taken into Your care, bless me in what You have given, and protect me from the evil of what You have decreed. For You decree and none can decree over You, and whoever You befriend is never humbled. Blessed are You, our Lord, and Exalted." Said in the Witr prayer.
  Word by word: اللَّهُمَّ Allāhumma = O Allah; اهْدِنِي -hdinī = guide me; فِيمَنْ هَدَيْتَ fīman hadayt = among those You guided; وَعَافِنِي wa ʿāfinī = and grant me well-being; فِيمَنْ عَافَيْتَ fīman ʿāfayt = among those You granted well-being; وَتَوَلَّنِي wa tawallanī = and take me into Your care; فِيمَنْ تَوَلَّيْتَ fīman tawallayt = among those You took into Your care; وَبَارِكْ لِي wa bārik lī = and bless for me; فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَ fīmā aʿṭayt = what You have given; وَقِنِي wa qinī = and protect me from; شَرَّ مَا قَضَيْتَ sharra mā qaḍayt = the evil of what You decreed; فَإِنَّكَ تَقْضِي fa innaka taqḍī = for You decree; وَلَا يُقْضَى عَلَيْكَ wa lā yuqḍā ʿalayk = and none decrees over You; وَإِنَّهُ لَا يَذِلُّ wa innahu lā yadhillu = and never humbled is; مَنْ وَالَيْتَ man wālayt = the one You befriend; تَبَارَكْتَ رَبَّنَا tabārakta Rabbanā = blessed are You, our Lord; وَتَعَالَيْتَ wa taʿālayt = and Exalted.
  Note: The supplication the Prophet ﷺ taught his grandson al-Hasan to say in Witr (Abu Dawud, al-Tirmidhi, al-Nasa'i). Other authentic wordings exist.
- [Subhanal Malikil Quddus](https://fahmsalah.com/salah/subhanal-malikil-quddus/): Subḥāna l-Maliki l-Quddūs (سُبْحَانَ الْمَلِكِ الْقُدُّوسِ) means "Glory be to the King, the Most Holy." Said after the Witr prayer.
  Word by word: سُبْحَانَ Subḥāna = Glory be to; الْمَلِكِ l-Maliki = the King; الْقُدُّوسِ l-Quddūs = the Most Holy.
  Note: Said three times after the salam of Witr, raising the voice the third time (al-Nasa'i, Abu Dawud).
- [Dua for breaking the fast (Dhahaba z-zama')](https://fahmsalah.com/salah/dua-iftar-dhahaba-zama/): Dhahaba ẓ-ẓamaʾu, wabtallati l-ʿurūqu, wa thabata l-ajru in shāʾ Allāh (ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ، وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ، وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ) means "The thirst is gone, the veins are moistened, and the reward is confirmed, if Allah wills." Said when breaking the fast.
  Word by word: ذَهَبَ Dhahaba = is gone; الظَّمَأُ ẓ-ẓamaʾu = the thirst; وَابْتَلَّتِ wabtallati = and moistened are; الْعُرُوقُ l-ʿurūqu = the veins; وَثَبَتَ wa thabata = and confirmed is; الْأَجْرُ l-ajru = the reward; إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ in shāʾ Allāh = if Allah wills.
  Note: Said by the Prophet ﷺ when he broke his fast (Abu Dawud). Begin your iftar with Bismillah.
- [Allahumma innaka 'afuwwun](https://fahmsalah.com/salah/allahumma-innaka-afuwwun/): Allāhumma innaka ʿAfuwwun tuḥibbu l-ʿafwa faʿfu ʿannī (اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي) means "O Allah, You are Pardoning and You love to pardon, so pardon me." Said in the last ten nights of Ramadan.
  Word by word: اللَّهُمَّ Allāhumma = O Allah; إِنَّكَ innaka = indeed You are; عَفُوٌّ ʿAfuwwun = Pardoning; تُحِبُّ tuḥibbu = You love; الْعَفْوَ l-ʿafwa = pardoning; فَاعْفُ faʿfu = so pardon; عَنِّي ʿannī = me.
  Note: Taught by the Prophet ﷺ to ʿAʾisha for Laylat al-Qadr, in the last ten nights of Ramadan (al-Tirmidhi).

## Les mots de la salât (français)

- [Allahu Akbar](https://fahmsalah.com/fr/salah/allahu-akbar/) : Allāhu akbar (اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ) veut dire « Allah est le plus Grand. » On le dit pour commencer la prière et à chaque changement de position.
  Mot à mot : اللَّهُ Allāhu = Allah ; أَكْبَرُ akbar = est le plus Grand.
  Note : Dit pour commencer la prière et en passant d'une position à l'autre. Tout le reste est plus petit qu'Allah : laisse le monde derrière toi.
- [Subhanaka Allahumma](https://fahmsalah.com/fr/salah/subhanaka-allahumma/) : Subḥānaka Allāhumma wa biḥamdika, wa tabāraka-smuka, wa taʿālā jadduka, wa lā ilāha ghayruk (سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ، وَتَعَالَى جَدُّكَ، وَلَا إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ) veut dire « Gloire à Toi, ô Allah, et louange à Toi. Béni soit Ton nom, exaltée soit Ta grandeur, et il n'y a de divinité que Toi. » On le dit après le takbir d'ouverture, avant Al-Fatiha.
  Mot à mot : سُبْحَانَكَ Subḥānaka = Gloire à Toi ; اللَّهُمَّ Allāhumma = ô Allah ; وَبِحَمْدِكَ wa biḥamdika = et par Ta louange ; وَتَبَارَكَ wa tabāraka = et béni soit ; اسْمُكَ -smuka = Ton nom ; وَتَعَالَى wa taʿālā = et exaltée soit ; جَدُّكَ jadduka = Ta grandeur ; وَلَا إِلَهَ wa lā ilāha = et il n'y a pas de divinité ; غَيْرُكَ ghayruk = autre que Toi.
  Note : L'une des invocations d'ouverture authentiques. Elle est recommandée, pas obligatoire.
- [A'udhu billahi minash shaytanir rajim](https://fahmsalah.com/fr/salah/audhu-billahi-minash-shaytanir-rajim/) : Aʿūdhu billāhi mina sh-shayṭāni r-rajīm (أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ) veut dire « Je cherche refuge auprès d'Allah contre Satan le maudit. » On le dit avant de réciter Al-Fatiha.
  Mot à mot : أَعُوذُ Aʿūdhu = Je cherche refuge ; بِاللَّهِ billāhi = auprès d'Allah ; مِنَ mina = contre ; الشَّيْطَانِ sh-shayṭāni = Satan ; الرَّجِيمِ r-rajīm = le maudit.
  Note : Dit à voix basse avant de réciter Al-Fatiha.
- [Subhana Rabbiyal Azim](https://fahmsalah.com/fr/salah/subhana-rabbiyal-azim/) : Subḥāna Rabbiya l-ʿAẓīm (سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْعَظِيمِ) veut dire « Gloire à mon Seigneur, le Très Grand. » On le dit en rukû', pendant l'inclinaison.
  Mot à mot : سُبْحَانَ Subḥāna = Gloire à ; رَبِّيَ Rabbiya = mon Seigneur ; الْعَظِيمِ l-ʿAẓīm = le Très Grand.
  Note : Généralement dit trois fois. Tu inclines ton corps et proclames Sa grandeur.
- [Sami Allahu liman hamidah](https://fahmsalah.com/fr/salah/sami-allahu-liman-hamidah/) : Samiʿa Allāhu liman ḥamidah (سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ) veut dire « Allah entend celui qui Le loue. » On le dit en se relevant du rukû'.
  Mot à mot : سَمِعَ Samiʿa = entend ; اللَّهُ Allāhu = Allah ; لِمَنْ liman = celui qui ; حَمِدَهُ ḥamidah = Le loue.
  Note : Dit en se relevant. Allah écoute : la réponse vient ensuite.
- [Rabbana wa lakal hamd](https://fahmsalah.com/fr/salah/rabbana-wa-lakal-hamd/) : Rabbanā wa laka l-ḥamd (رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ) veut dire « Notre Seigneur, à Toi la louange. » On le dit debout, juste après le rukû'.
  Mot à mot : رَبَّنَا Rabbanā = Notre Seigneur ; وَلَكَ wa laka = et à Toi ; الْحَمْدُ l-ḥamd = la louange.
  Note : Ta réponse à « Allah entend celui qui Le loue ».
- [Subhana Rabbiyal A'la](https://fahmsalah.com/fr/salah/subhana-rabbiyal-ala/) : Subḥāna Rabbiya l-Aʿlā (سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْأَعْلَى) veut dire « Gloire à mon Seigneur, le Très Haut. » On le dit en sujûd, pendant la prosternation.
  Mot à mot : سُبْحَانَ Subḥāna = Gloire à ; رَبِّيَ Rabbiya = mon Seigneur ; الْأَعْلَى l-Aʿlā = le Très Haut.
  Note : Généralement dit trois fois. Au point le plus bas, tu glorifies le Très Haut.
- [Rabbighfir li](https://fahmsalah.com/fr/salah/rabbighfirli/) : Rabbi-ghfir lī (رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي) veut dire « Mon Seigneur, pardonne-moi. » On le dit assis entre les deux prosternations.
  Mot à mot : رَبِّ Rabbi = Mon Seigneur ; اغْفِرْ -ghfir = pardonne ; لِي lī = -moi.
  Note : Souvent dit deux fois, assis entre les deux prosternations.
- [Attahiyat](https://fahmsalah.com/fr/salah/attahiyat/) : At-taḥiyyātu lillāhi waṣ-ṣalawātu waṭ-ṭayyibāt, as-salāmu ʿalayka ayyuha n-nabiyyu wa raḥmatullāhi wa barakātuh, as-salāmu ʿalaynā wa ʿalā ʿibādillāhi ṣ-ṣāliḥīn (التَّحِيَّاتُ لِلَّهِ وَالصَّلَوَاتُ وَالطَّيِّبَاتُ، السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ، السَّلَامُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ) veut dire « Les salutations, les prières et les bonnes choses sont à Allah. Que la paix soit sur toi, ô Prophète, ainsi que la miséricorde d'Allah et Ses bénédictions. Que la paix soit sur nous et sur les pieux serviteurs d'Allah. » On le dit en position assise (tashahhud).
  Mot à mot : التَّحِيَّاتُ At-taḥiyyātu = Les salutations ; لِلَّهِ lillāhi = sont à Allah ; وَالصَّلَوَاتُ waṣ-ṣalawātu = et les prières ; وَالطَّيِّبَاتُ waṭ-ṭayyibāt = et les bonnes choses ; السَّلَامُ as-salāmu = La paix ; عَلَيْكَ ʿalayka = sur toi ; أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ ayyuha n-nabiyyu = ô Prophète ; وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ wa raḥmatullāhi = et la miséricorde d'Allah ; وَبَرَكَاتُهُ wa barakātuh = et Ses bénédictions ; السَّلَامُ عَلَيْنَا as-salāmu ʿalaynā = La paix sur nous ; وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ wa ʿalā ʿibādillāhi = et sur les serviteurs d'Allah ; الصَّالِحِينَ ṣ-ṣāliḥīn = pieux.
  Note : La formulation d'Ibn Mas'ûd, rapportée par al-Bukhârî et Muslim. D'autres formulations authentiques existent.
- [Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah](https://fahmsalah.com/fr/salah/ashhadu-an-la-ilaha-illallah/) : Ash-hadu an lā ilāha illallāh, wa ash-hadu anna Muḥammadan ʿabduhu wa rasūluh (أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ) veut dire « J'atteste qu'il n'y a de divinité qu'Allah, et j'atteste que Muhammad est Son serviteur et Son messager. » On le dit dans le tashahhud, juste après les salutations.
  Mot à mot : أَشْهَدُ Ash-hadu = J'atteste ; أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ an lā ilāha = qu'il n'y a pas de divinité ; إِلَّا اللَّهُ illallāh = sauf Allah ; وَأَشْهَدُ wa ash-hadu = et j'atteste ; أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا anna Muḥammadan = que Muhammad ; عَبْدُهُ ʿabduhu = est Son serviteur ; وَرَسُولُهُ wa rasūluh = et Son messager.
  Note : Le témoignage de foi, renouvelé à chaque prière.
- [Allahumma salli ala Muhammad](https://fahmsalah.com/fr/salah/allahumma-salli-ala-muhammad/) : Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli Muḥammad, kamā ṣallayta ʿalā Ibrāhīma wa ʿalā āli Ibrāhīm, innaka Ḥamīdun Majīd (اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ) veut dire « Ô Allah, prie sur Muhammad et sur la famille de Muhammad, comme Tu as prié sur Ibrahim et sur la famille d'Ibrahim. Tu es certes Digne de louange et Glorieux. » On le dit dans la dernière position assise, après le tashahhud.
  Mot à mot : اللَّهُمَّ Allāhumma = Ô Allah ; صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammadin = prie sur Muhammad ; وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ wa ʿalā āli Muḥammad = et sur la famille de Muhammad ; كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ kamā ṣallayta = comme Tu as prié ; عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ ʿalā Ibrāhīma = sur Ibrahim ; وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ wa ʿalā āli Ibrāhīm = et sur la famille d'Ibrahim ; إِنَّكَ innaka = Tu es certes ; حَمِيدٌ Ḥamīdun = Digne de louange ; مَجِيدٌ Majīd = Glorieux.
  Note : Dit lors de la dernière position assise. L'une des formulations authentiques, rapportée par al-Bukhârî.
- [Allahumma barik ala Muhammad](https://fahmsalah.com/fr/salah/allahumma-barik-ala-muhammad/) : Allāhumma bārik ʿalā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli Muḥammad, kamā bārakta ʿalā Ibrāhīma wa ʿalā āli Ibrāhīm, innaka Ḥamīdun Majīd (اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ) veut dire « Ô Allah, bénis Muhammad et la famille de Muhammad, comme Tu as béni Ibrahim et la famille d'Ibrahim. Tu es certes Digne de louange et Glorieux. » On le dit dans la dernière position assise, juste après la salât sur le Prophète.
  Mot à mot : اللَّهُمَّ Allāhumma = Ô Allah ; بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ bārik ʿalā Muḥammadin = bénis Muhammad ; وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ wa ʿalā āli Muḥammad = et la famille de Muhammad ; كَمَا بَارَكْتَ kamā bārakta = comme Tu as béni ; عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ ʿalā Ibrāhīma = Ibrahim ; وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ wa ʿalā āli Ibrāhīm = et la famille d'Ibrahim ; إِنَّكَ innaka = Tu es certes ; حَمِيدٌ Ḥamīdun = Digne de louange ; مَجِيدٌ Majīd = Glorieux.
  Note : La seconde moitié de la prière sur le Prophète ﷺ.
- [Assalamu alaykum wa rahmatullah](https://fahmsalah.com/fr/salah/assalamu-alaykum-wa-rahmatullah/) : As-salāmu ʿalaykum wa raḥmatullāh (السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ) veut dire « Que la paix soit sur vous, ainsi que la miséricorde d'Allah. » On le dit pour terminer la prière, en tournant la tête à droite, puis à gauche.
  Mot à mot : السَّلَامُ As-salāmu = La paix ; عَلَيْكُمْ ʿalaykum = soit sur vous ; وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ wa raḥmatullāh = et la miséricorde d'Allah.
  Note : Dit en tournant la tête vers la droite, puis vers la gauche.
- [Astaghfirullah](https://fahmsalah.com/fr/salah/astaghfirullah/) : Astaghfirullāh (أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ) veut dire « Je demande pardon à Allah. » On le dit juste après le salam d'une prière obligatoire.
  Mot à mot : أَسْتَغْفِرُ Astaghfiru = Je demande pardon à ; اللَّهَ llāh = Allah.
  Note : Dit trois fois juste après le salam (Muslim). Même après l'adoration, on demande pardon pour ses manquements.
- [Allahumma antas salam](https://fahmsalah.com/fr/salah/allahumma-antas-salam/) : Allāhumma anta s-Salām, wa minka s-salām, tabārakta yā Dha l-Jalāli wa l-Ikrām (اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ، وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ) veut dire « Ô Allah, Tu es la Paix et de Toi vient la paix. Béni sois-Tu, ô Détenteur de la Majesté et de la Noblesse. » On le dit juste après la prière, après Astaghfirullah.
  Mot à mot : اللَّهُمَّ Allāhumma = Ô Allah ; أَنْتَ anta = Tu es ; السَّلَامُ s-Salām = la Paix ; وَمِنْكَ wa minka = et de Toi ; السَّلَامُ s-salām = (vient) la paix ; تَبَارَكْتَ tabārakta = Béni sois-Tu ; يَا ذَا yā Dha = ô Détenteur de ; الْجَلَالِ l-Jalāli = la Majesté ; وَالْإِكْرَامِ wa l-Ikrām = et de la Noblesse.
  Note : Dit une fois, après l'istighfar (Muslim). As-Salâm, la Paix, est l'un des noms d'Allah.
- [SubhanAllah](https://fahmsalah.com/fr/salah/subhanallah/) : Subḥāna llāh (سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ) veut dire « Gloire à Allah. » On le dit après la prière obligatoire, et à tout moment.
  Mot à mot : سُبْحَانَ Subḥāna = Gloire à ; اللَّهِ llāh = Allah.
  Note : Dit 33 fois après la prière obligatoire (Muslim). Tu déclares Allah au-dessus de toute imperfection.
- [Alhamdulillah](https://fahmsalah.com/fr/salah/alhamdulillah/) : Al-ḥamdu lillāh (الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ) veut dire « La louange est à Allah. » On le dit après la prière obligatoire, et à tout moment.
  Mot à mot : الْحَمْدُ Al-ḥamdu = La louange ; لِلَّهِ lillāh = est à Allah.
  Note : Dit 33 fois (Muslim). Les mêmes mots qui ouvrent Al-Fatiha.
- [La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah](https://fahmsalah.com/fr/salah/la-ilaha-illallahu-wahdahu-la-sharika-lah/) : Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahu l-mulku wa lahu l-ḥamd, wa huwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr (لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ) veut dire « Il n'y a de divinité qu'Allah, Seul, sans associé. À Lui la royauté et à Lui la louange, et Il est capable de toute chose. » On le dit après la prière obligatoire, pour compléter la centaine.
  Mot à mot : لَا إِلَهَ lā ilāha = il n'y a pas de divinité ; إِلَّا اللَّهُ illallāhu = sauf Allah ; وَحْدَهُ waḥdahu = Seul ; لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ lā sharīka lah = sans associé ; لَهُ الْمُلْكُ lahu l-mulku = à Lui la royauté ; وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ wa lahu l-ḥamd = et à Lui la louange ; وَهُوَ wa huwa = et Il est ; عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ ʿalā kulli shayʾin = sur toute chose ; قَدِيرٌ qadīr = capable.
  Note : Dit une fois pour compléter la centaine. Celui qui les dit après chaque prière voit ses péchés pardonnés, même s'ils étaient comme l'écume de la mer (Muslim).
- [Allahumma la mani'a lima a'tayta](https://fahmsalah.com/fr/salah/allahumma-la-mania-lima-atayta/) : Allāhumma lā māniʿa limā aʿṭayt, wa lā muʿṭiya limā manaʿt, wa lā yanfaʿu dha l-jaddi minka l-jadd (اللَّهُمَّ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ) veut dire « Ô Allah, nul ne peut retenir ce que Tu donnes, nul ne peut donner ce que Tu retiens, et la fortune de personne ne lui sert contre Toi. » On le dit après la prière obligatoire.
  Mot à mot : اللَّهُمَّ Allāhumma = Ô Allah ; لَا مَانِعَ lā māniʿa = nul ne peut retenir ; لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ limā aʿṭayt = ce que Tu donnes ; وَلَا مُعْطِيَ wa lā muʿṭiya = et nul ne peut donner ; لِمَا مَنَعْتَ limā manaʿt = ce que Tu retiens ; وَلَا يَنْفَعُ wa lā yanfaʿu = et ne sert pas ; ذَا الْجَدِّ dha l-jaddi = celui qui a la fortune ; مِنْكَ minka = contre Toi ; الْجَدُّ l-jadd = sa fortune.
  Note : Le Prophète ﷺ disait cela après le tahlîl à la fin de chaque prière obligatoire (al-Bukhârî, Muslim).
- [Allahumma a'inni ala dhikrika](https://fahmsalah.com/fr/salah/allahumma-ainni-ala-dhikrika/) : Allāhumma aʿinnī ʿalā dhikrika wa shukrika wa ḥusni ʿibādatik (اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ) veut dire « Ô Allah, aide-moi à T'invoquer, à Te remercier et à bien T'adorer. » On le dit après la prière.
  Mot à mot : اللَّهُمَّ Allāhumma = Ô Allah ; أَعِنِّي aʿinnī = aide-moi ; عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ ʿalā dhikrika = à T'invoquer ; وَشُكْرِكَ wa shukrika = et à Te remercier ; وَحُسْنِ wa ḥusni = et à bien accomplir ; عِبَادَتِكَ ʿibādatik = Ton adoration.
  Note : Le Prophète ﷺ a recommandé à Muʿâdh de ne jamais manquer de dire cela à la fin de chaque prière (Abû Dâwûd, an-Nasâ'î).
- [Dua Qunut (Witr)](https://fahmsalah.com/fr/salah/dua-qunut-witr/) : Allāhumma-hdinī fīman hadayt, wa ʿāfinī fīman ʿāfayt, wa tawallanī fīman tawallayt, wa bārik lī fīmā aʿṭayt, wa qinī sharra mā qaḍayt, fa innaka taqḍī wa lā yuqḍā ʿalayk, wa innahu lā yadhillu man wālayt, tabārakta Rabbanā wa taʿālayt (اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي فِيمَنْ هَدَيْتَ، وَعَافِنِي فِيمَنْ عَافَيْتَ، وَتَوَلَّنِي فِيمَنْ تَوَلَّيْتَ، وَبَارِكْ لِي فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَقِنِي شَرَّ مَا قَضَيْتَ، فَإِنَّكَ تَقْضِي وَلَا يُقْضَى عَلَيْكَ، وَإِنَّهُ لَا يَذِلُّ مَنْ وَالَيْتَ، تَبَارَكْتَ رَبَّنَا وَتَعَالَيْتَ) veut dire « Ô Allah, guide-moi parmi ceux que Tu as guidés, accorde-moi le bien-être parmi ceux à qui Tu l'as accordé, prends-moi sous Ta protection parmi ceux que Tu as pris sous Ta protection, bénis pour moi ce que Tu m'as donné, et préserve-moi du mal de ce que Tu as décrété. Car c'est Toi qui décrètes et nul ne décrète contre Toi, et celui que Tu prends pour allié n'est jamais humilié. Béni sois-Tu, notre Seigneur, et exalté. » On le dit dans la prière du witr.
  Mot à mot : اللَّهُمَّ Allāhumma = Ô Allah ; اهْدِنِي -hdinī = guide-moi ; فِيمَنْ هَدَيْتَ fīman hadayt = parmi ceux que Tu as guidés ; وَعَافِنِي wa ʿāfinī = et accorde-moi le bien-être ; فِيمَنْ عَافَيْتَ fīman ʿāfayt = parmi ceux à qui Tu l'as accordé ; وَتَوَلَّنِي wa tawallanī = et prends-moi sous Ta protection ; فِيمَنْ تَوَلَّيْتَ fīman tawallayt = parmi ceux que Tu as protégés ; وَبَارِكْ لِي wa bārik lī = et bénis pour moi ; فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَ fīmā aʿṭayt = ce que Tu as donné ; وَقِنِي wa qinī = et préserve-moi de ; شَرَّ مَا قَضَيْتَ sharra mā qaḍayt = le mal de ce que Tu as décrété ; فَإِنَّكَ تَقْضِي fa innaka taqḍī = car c'est Toi qui décrètes ; وَلَا يُقْضَى عَلَيْكَ wa lā yuqḍā ʿalayk = et nul ne décrète contre Toi ; وَإِنَّهُ لَا يَذِلُّ wa innahu lā yadhillu = et jamais n'est humilié ; مَنْ وَالَيْتَ man wālayt = celui que Tu prends pour allié ; تَبَارَكْتَ رَبَّنَا tabārakta Rabbanā = béni sois-Tu, notre Seigneur ; وَتَعَالَيْتَ wa taʿālayt = et exalté.
  Note : L'invocation que le Prophète ﷺ a enseignée à son petit-fils al-Hasan pour le witr (Abû Dâwûd, at-Tirmidhî, an-Nasâ'î). D'autres formulations authentiques existent.
- [Subhanal Malikil Quddus](https://fahmsalah.com/fr/salah/subhanal-malikil-quddus/) : Subḥāna l-Maliki l-Quddūs (سُبْحَانَ الْمَلِكِ الْقُدُّوسِ) veut dire « Gloire au Roi, le Très Saint. » On le dit après la prière du witr.
  Mot à mot : سُبْحَانَ Subḥāna = Gloire au ; الْمَلِكِ l-Maliki = Roi ; الْقُدُّوسِ l-Quddūs = le Très Saint.
  Note : Dit trois fois après le salam du witr, en élevant la voix la troisième fois (an-Nasâ'î, Abû Dâwûd).
- [Dua for breaking the fast (Dhahaba z-zama')](https://fahmsalah.com/fr/salah/dua-iftar-dhahaba-zama/) : Dhahaba ẓ-ẓamaʾu, wabtallati l-ʿurūqu, wa thabata l-ajru in shāʾ Allāh (ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ، وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ، وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ) veut dire « La soif est partie, les veines sont humectées, et la récompense est acquise, si Allah le veut. » On le dit à la rupture du jeûne.
  Mot à mot : ذَهَبَ Dhahaba = est partie ; الظَّمَأُ ẓ-ẓamaʾu = la soif ; وَابْتَلَّتِ wabtallati = et sont humectées ; الْعُرُوقُ l-ʿurūqu = les veines ; وَثَبَتَ wa thabata = et est acquise ; الْأَجْرُ l-ajru = la récompense ; إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ in shāʾ Allāh = si Allah le veut.
  Note : Dit par le Prophète ﷺ lorsqu'il rompait son jeûne (Abû Dâwûd). Commence ton iftar par Bismillah.
- [Allahumma innaka 'afuwwun](https://fahmsalah.com/fr/salah/allahumma-innaka-afuwwun/) : Allāhumma innaka ʿAfuwwun tuḥibbu l-ʿafwa faʿfu ʿannī (اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي) veut dire « Ô Allah, Tu es Celui qui pardonne et Tu aimes le pardon, alors pardonne-moi. » On le dit pendant les dix dernières nuits du Ramadan.
  Mot à mot : اللَّهُمَّ Allāhumma = Ô Allah ; إِنَّكَ innaka = certes Tu es ; عَفُوٌّ ʿAfuwwun = Celui qui pardonne ; تُحِبُّ tuḥibbu = Tu aimes ; الْعَفْوَ l-ʿafwa = le pardon ; فَاعْفُ faʿfu = alors pardonne ; عَنِّي ʿannī = -moi.
  Note : Enseignée par le Prophète ﷺ à ʿÂ'icha pour Laylat al-Qadr, durant les dix dernières nuits du Ramadan (at-Tirmidhî).
